title: Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Shipment Planning: From Supply Days to Packages
content:
**Tailwise Pharmacy supply planning — packages in a prescription Autoship shipment**

§1 The package count of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy shipment under Tailwise Autoship is planned from the supply days the shipment is planned to carry. A standard shipment is planned to carry 30 days of supply.

§2 One package lasts the linked prescription's days' supply per fill divided by its packages per fill, both as the prescription on file shows them.

§3 The package count is the planned supply days divided by the days one package lasts, rounded up to a whole package, and never less than one package.

§4 The package count never exceeds the lowest of three limits: the packages that one fill of the linked prescription authorizes; the program's most units per shipment; and the whole number of packages whose combined days of supply fit within the program's largest days' supply in one shipment (that largest days' supply divided by the days one package lasts, rounded down to a whole package).

## Worked figures (hypothetical prescriptions and program limits)

Assume, for each case, a program limit of 3 packages per shipment and 90 days' supply per shipment.

| Prescription per fill | Days one package lasts | Planned supply days | Packages needed (rounded up) | Fill limit | Days limit | Package count |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 90 days, 3 packages | 30 | 30 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 1 |
| 30 days, 6 packages | 5 | 30 | 6 | 6 | 18 | 3 |
| 84 days, 3 packages | 28 | 30 | 2 (30 divided by 28 is about 1.07) | 3 | 3 | 2 |
| 180 days, 2 packages | 90 | 30 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 1 |

In the second row the program's limit of 3 packages is the lowest of the limits. In the fourth row one package already holds 90 days, so only one fits within the 90-day limit.

## Points of judgement

- Rounding up happens once, on the planned supply days divided by the days one package lasts; the days limit is rounded down.
- Never less than one package: planned supply days shorter than one package still give one package.
